title: DriveDreamer: Towards Real-world-driven World Models for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: multi-view images and driving video (448x256), plus future driving actions as a second output

control_signal.value: HDMap and 3D boxes with labels, text prompts (weather, time of day), reference frame, and ego driving actions (yaw angle, velocity) to steer future videos

control_mechanism.value: HDMap concatenated with noisy latents; 3D boxes via gated self-attention; text via cross-attention; ActionFormer predicts future road structural features from actions as conditions for Auto-DM

base_model.value: Auto-DM built on Stable Diffusion v1.4 with frozen original parameters, added temporal attention layers, ActionFormer and an action decoder

datasets.value: nuScenes: 700 training and 150 validation videos, 12Hz; HDMap from nuScenes-devkit, 12Hz boxes supplemented from another source

metrics.value: frame-wise FID and FVD; 3D detection mAP and NDS with FCOS3D and BEVFusion on synthetic data; open-loop planning L2 and collision rate

controllability_evidence.value: Synthetic data from 4K traffic conditions raises BEVFusion mAP 32.8 to 35.8 (+3.0) and FCOS3D mAP 30.2 to 30.9; action-conditioned videos are shown qualitatively (turn left or right).

closed_loop.value: no; open-loop only. Predicts 16 frames and 16 future actions, and open-loop planning is evaluated on nuScenes over 3 seconds

notes: Packet does not include FID/FVD numbers or an explicit limitations section. Action control evidence is qualitative in the packet.
